import sys, os
from copy import copy
from unittest.mock import patch
from pylint import modify_sys_path

cwd = 'C:/Windows/Temp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_do_not_import_files_from_0'
default_paths = ['/usr/local/lib/python39.zip','/usr/local/lib/python3.9','/usr/local/lib/python3.9/lib-dynload','/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages']
from contextlib import contextmanager
@contextmanager
def env(v):
    old = os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH')
    if v is None: os.environ.pop('PYTHONPATH', None)
    else: os.environ['PYTHONPATH'] = v
    try: yield
    finally:
        if old is None: os.environ.pop('PYTHONPATH', None)
        else: os.environ['PYTHONPATH'] = old

with patch('os.getcwd') as m:
    m.return_value = cwd
    cases = [
        ([cwd, *default_paths], None, lambda p: p[1:]),
        ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], '.', lambda p: p[1:]),
        ([cwd, '/custom_pythonpath', *default_paths], '/custom_pythonpath', lambda p: p[1:]),
        ([cwd, '/custom_pythonpath', cwd, *default_paths], '/custom_pythonpath:', lambda p: [p[1]] + p[3:]),
        (['', cwd, '/custom_pythonpath', *default_paths], ':/custom_pythonpath', lambda p: p[2:]),
        ([cwd, cwd, '/custom_pythonpath', *default_paths], ':/custom_pythonpath:', lambda p: p[2:]),
        ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], ':.', lambda p: p[1:]),
        ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], f':{cwd}', lambda p: p[1:]),
        ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], '.:', lambda p: p[1:]),
        ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], f'{cwd}:', lambda p: p[1:]),
        (['', cwd, *default_paths, cwd], cwd, lambda p: p[1:]),
    ]
    for paths, pyenv, expect in cases:
        sys.path = copy(paths)
        with env(pyenv):
            modify_sys_path()
        assert sys.path == expect(paths), (pyenv, paths, sys.path)
print('OK: all 11 test_modify_sys_path scenarios pass with the fix')
"
